risk_summary: The disclosure identifies meaningful exposure to supply-chain disruption, inflation, customer order cancellations, macroeconomic conditions, and estimation uncertainty. It provides some useful quantified information, including backlog, deposits, cash flows, and lead-time context, but frequently relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and nonquantified adverse-impact language. Overall tone is cautiously negative regarding external risks, while management remains confident in its ability to fulfill orders.
